data.body: chunk12 fix (SHA 0f51601b96): ROOT CAUSE of parent OUTBOUND FAIL + Phase-6 idempotency churn found. The production outbound dispatch routes through applier.update_one (via _apply_batch), whose _OUTBOUND_BATCH_ALLOWLIST did NOT include 'parent'. Parent-only update mutations were stripped to empty fields and client.set_parent was NEVER called -> parent never landed in Jira -> next fetch shows no parent -> differ re-emits the identical parent mutation every pass. Compute-only live diagnosis (nothing applied) found ~259 steady-state fields=['parent'] re-emitters across consecutive passes (verbatim: nearly every bound child DIG-4175..DIG-5335). Live get_parent_map(DIG) returned only 1 non-null parent project-wide, confirming no outbound parent ever landed; editmeta confirms parent is PUT-editable. Fix mirrors the typed leaf _apply_outbound_update: pop parent before allowlist, route via set_parent (REST PUT) with HTTP-400 hierarchy guard, skip empty update_issue. RED->GREEN: tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_update_one_parent_routing.py (4 tests; 3 RED pre-fix). Suite 792 passed / 1 pre-existing fail (test_e2e_dedup_pass, independent) / 2 xfailed. Stale-binding non-parent re-emitter cluster (detected_by:* tickets bound to out-of-window/deleted Jira issues) tracked separately as 1e08-1a35-0267-4ca6.
